title: Repository Local Proof Continuity Contract
purpose: Keep repository planning, building, validation, and integration productive when hosted CI is quota-limited, rate-limited, unavailable, or permission-blocked without inflating local proof into hosted or live proof.
principles: Hosted CI is one proof surface, not the sole execution authority.
Repository work that depends on validation must establish or reuse a repository-native local proof path before hosted CI becomes a single point of failure.
A known non-transient provider limit must not be retried as a substitute for progress.
Local proof is typed evidence and never silently proves hosted-runner execution, deployment, live runtime behavior, or operator acceptance.
planning_requirements: Name the canonical local validation owner or launcher for every repository lane that requires proof.
Name the exact local command or deterministic entrypoint, its required inputs/base identity, expected receipt or observable result, and nonzero-exit behavior.
Separate gates that local proof can close from gates that contractually require hosted CI or another protected environment.
If no trustworthy local proof path exists and creating one belongs to the planned scope, schedule the smallest durable proof seam before relying on hosted CI.
Prefer one repository-native proof owner over per-PR ad hoc fallback scripts.
execution_requirements: Refresh provider state before classifying a hosted failure.
When provider state is QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, RATE_LIMITED, RUNNER_UNAVAILABLE, or PERMISSION_DENIED, continue through the canonical local proof path for every gate it can honestly prove.
Suppress blind hosted retries while the evidenced non-transient provider state is unchanged.
If the local proof owner is missing and the active lane owns that seam, build the smallest deterministic local validator or launcher and prove it before continuing.
If the local proof owner is missing but another owner controls it, preserve that exact gap as REQUIRED SUCCESSOR WORK or AUTONOMY_GAP while continuing independent executable work.
Keep any genuinely hosted-only required gate BLOCKED until that environment is observed; do not relabel local PASS as hosted PASS.
minimum_local_proof_receipt: proof-relevance fingerprint or equivalent versioned input set
command result with nonzero failures propagated
anti_patterns: Stopping the whole sprint solely because hosted Actions or another CI provider is quota-exhausted when local proof can still advance the requested gate.
Repeatedly triggering a provider already proven quota-exhausted or otherwise non-transiently unavailable.
Treating an open PR, workflow file, queued run, zero-step run, or provider ACK as validation.
Inventing a local PASS without executing the repository-owned validator/build/test path.
Promoting local proof to hosted, deployed, live-runtime, or operator-acceptance proof.
proof_ceiling: This contract can require and type repository-local continuity proof. It cannot by itself prove hosted-runner execution, deployment, live runtime behavior, external credentials, or operator acceptance.
